note: Banque de sons réutilisables (consigne de Matis du 05/11/2026) : avant de générer un son, chercher ici. Relire un son avec creative_get_generations(flow_id, generation_ids) : 0 crédit, lien signé neuf. Tout nouveau son généré est ajouté ici.

sfx.name: buzz
sfx.prompt: Close-up of a smartphone vibrating on a wooden nightstand in a silent room, rhythmic buzzing pattern, rattling against the wood and a glass of water.

sfx.name: rain
sfx.prompt: Steady rain on a bedroom window at night, heard from inside a quiet room, muffled distant city traffic, soft room tone.

sfx.name: breath
sfx.prompt: Slow nervous human breathing very close to a telephone microphone, heard through a phone line with faint static.

sfx.name: hangup
sfx.prompt: Telephone line goes dead: one soft click followed by three short flat electronic beeps, then silence.

sfx.name: boom
sfx.prompt: Deep cinematic sub-bass impact, dark film trailer hit with a long low tail, no melody.

sfx.name: riser
sfx.prompt: Dark cinematic tension riser, low strings and air building steadily for four seconds, then stopping dead.

sfx.name: tick
sfx.prompt: Single small dry mechanical click of a bedside digital alarm clock changing minute.

sfx.name: whoosh
sfx.prompt: Soft low dark cinematic whoosh for a hard cut, airy, short.

sfx.name: heart
sfx.prompt: Slow heavy human heartbeat, muffled and low, cinematic, felt more than heard.

sfx.name: door
sfx.prompt: Heavy door slam in an empty stairwell, long concrete reverb.

sfx.name: callcenter
sfx.prompt: Empty office call center at night, low hum of computers and fluorescent lights, air conditioning, very faint distant electronic beeps, quiet room tone, no voices.

sfx.name: typing
sfx.prompt: Fast nervous typing on a computer keyboard, close-up, crisp key clicks, quiet office, stops abruptly.

sfx.name: knock
sfx.desc: Coups frappés à une porte d'appartement, deux paires (fichier : coups à 1,66 / 1,85 / 2,62 / 2,83 s). offset 1,5 + trim 0,55 = une paire ; offset 2,45 + trim 0,6 = l'autre. BLACK-OUT nuit 1.

sfx.name: powerdown
sfx.desc: Coupure de courant : bourdonnement électrique qui s'éteint d'un coup (pic à 0,25 s, puis silence). BLACK-OUT nuit 1.

sfx.name: shout
sfx.desc: Quelqu'un crie un prénom au loin dans la rue, sous la pluie (sans mot compréhensible). BLACK-OUT nuit 1.

sfx.name: handle
sfx.desc: Poignée de porte qu'on essaie de tourner, verrou qui résiste. BLACK-OUT nuit 1.

sfx.name: coins
sfx.desc: Caisse enregistreuse puis pièces dans un coffre (FROMAGISTAN).

sfx.name: win-fanfare
sfx.desc: Fanfare de victoire avec petite foule (FROMAGISTAN).

music.name: score-tension
music.prompt: Minimal dark thriller underscore for a suspense short film. Sub-bass drone, sparse detuned felt piano notes, distant metallic textures, a slow pulse like a heartbeat that gradually tightens over the whole track. No melody hook, no drums, no vocals. Restrained, adult, cinematic, leaves plenty of room for a voice-over.

music.name: theme-fromagistan
music.desc: Thème joyeux de jeu mobile : ukulélé, pizzicati, marimba (FROMAGISTAN).
